But I don’t know if that’s “worrying” or just… my brain jumping around.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period where you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?\n\nPatient: I’m not sure… I mean, I have nights where I don’t sleep great, but I don’t know that I’d say I need much less sleep and feel amazing or anything.\n\nSometimes I’ll stay up too late because I get caught up doing something, like looking at vendor catalogs or reorganizing something that suddenly feels important, and then the next day I’m still kind of wired for a bit. I don’t know if that makes sense.\n\nDoctor: Do these feelings ever come on as sudden surges of intense fear or discomfort that peak within a few minutes?\n\nPatient: Um… I don’t think so? Not like a sudden wave of fear that hits and peaks really fast. I mean, I get uncomfortable sometimes, but it’s more like this ongoing revved-up feeling, if that makes sense.\n\nAlthough “peak within a few minutes” makes me think of when I’m in a crowded store and everyone’s moving too slowly—sorry, that’s probably not what you mean. I don’t really notice it as intense fear, more just… I can’t settle.\n\nDoctor: Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different parts of your life, even when there isn’t an obvious reason to worry?\n\nPatient: I’m not sure I’d call it worrying, exactly. But I don’t know if that’s “worrying” or just… my brain jumping around.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period where you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?\n\nPatient: I’m not sure… I mean, I have nights where I don’t sleep great, but I don’t know that I’d say I need much less sleep and feel amazing or anything.\n\nSometimes I’ll stay up too late because I get caught up doing something, like looking at vendor catalogs or reorganizing something that suddenly feels important, and then the next day I’m still kind of wired for a bit. But, yes, the main thing was I had trouble staying still and waiting my turn, especially in class.\n\nDoctor: Do you still often interrupt people or have trouble waiting your turn as an adult?\n\nPatient: Yes… I do still do that, though I don’t always notice it right away. Waiting for the right opening is… not always my strong suit.\n\nDoctor: Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to pay attention?\n\nPatient: I mean… sometimes, yes, but I’m not sure I’d describe it exactly that way.
